create_context_prediction_pairs: create context-prediction sentence pairs from ground truth and predicted document sequences with a max context length
create_teacher_forced_eval_data: create teacher-forced generation evaluation data by pairing predicted sentences with preceding ground truth context sentences
divide_chunks_as: divide an iterable into chunks sized according to the lengths of reference sequences
summarize_create_context_prediction_pair: summarize the create_context_prediction_pairs function that yields context and prediction sentence pairs for evaluation
review_divide_chunks_as: review the divide_chunks_as function that splits an iterable into chunks matching reference sequence lengths
